Perfect lunch stop mid-hike. The Grand Ballon circuit starts from the GBA parking area. Note: May 1 is a holiday - call ahead to confirm they are open (+33 3 89 76 93 43 or similar).

Stock up on snacks and water for the hike. The Sentier des Roches trailhead is near Munster (approx. 30 min drive from Gerardmer).
primary.notes_local: Depart tot necessaire pour le Sentier des Roches. Preparer le petit-dejeuner a l'appartement. Preparer des encas et de l'eau pour la randonnee.

primary.notes_base: THE quintessential ferme-auberge experience in the Vosges. Located in the Wormsa valley near the Sentier des Roches, this working farm serves hearty traditional Alsatian food with ingredients from the farm. Often full - call ahead to reserve: +33 3 89 77 61 59. Baeckeoffe and Munster are the must-orders. Cash only (many ferme-auberges in the region). Closed Mondays and Tuesdays - confirm open on Saturday May 2.
primary.notes_local: Ferme-auberge emblematique des Vosges dans la vallee de la Wormsa, pres du Sentier des Roches. Reservation indispensable: +33 3 89 77 61 59. Paiement en especes souvent requis. Ferme lundi et mardi - confirmer ouverture samedi 2 mai.

primary.notes_base: Ferme-auberge in the Lac Blanc area, right on or near the Tour des Trois Lacs route (Lac Blanc, Lac Noir, Lac des Truites). Perfect for a mid-hike lunch break with lake views. Traditional Alsatian farm food. Open weekends - confirm by phone before the trip. This is a fitting farewell meal before returning to Paris. The area around Lac Blanc is stunning in May with clear skies.

The Trois Lacs circuit passes through beautiful forested terrain with lake viewpoints - any of the three lakes makes an idyllic picnic spot. Allows more time for fishing at the lakes.

primary.signature_dishes_local: Collations et repas legers achetes a la gare d'Epinal ou Remiremont, ou encas du bar SNCF; ou sandwichs prepares a Gerardmer
primary.notes_base: After the Trois Lacs hike, the return journey to Paris is a priority. Allow adequate time for the taxi/bus to the train station (Remiremont or Epinal, approximately 45-60 min from Gerardmer/Orbey). Pack a substantial trail snack or buy a hot meal at the station before boarding. Journey time Paris is approximately 4h with TER + TGV connection. Buying provisions in Gerardmer before leaving (local Munster, charcuterie, bread) makes for an authentic picnic on the train.
primary.notes_local: Apres la randonnee des Trois Lacs, prevoir suffisamment de temps pour le transport vers la gare (Remiremont ou Epinal, environ 45-60 min). Acheter un repas chaud a la gare ou preparer des provisions a Gerardmer. Trajet retour vers Paris environ 4h.

The Grand Hotel restaurant offers a more elevated experience for a farewell meal - slightly over budget at 28 EUR per person but a nice splurge for the last evening. Reservation recommended.
